label: Printful variants
description: Links each Swell variant to the Printful variant it was synced from. Written by the product sync; the rate and order paths follow these links.

sync_variant_id.description: Printful sync variant id, and this row's identity. Orders reference it, so Printful prints the files stored with the design. Marked unique, which in Swell is a read-then-write validation rather than a database index

sync_product_id.description: Printful product this variant belongs to

catalog_variant_id.description: Printful catalog variant the design is printed on. Shipping quotes ask for this

product_id.description: Swell product created from the Printful product

variant_id.description: Swell product variant this Printful variant is sold as

date_synced.description: When this link last matched Printful
